_comment: The complaint that stung most: 'it already asked question and did the code and raised PR as well but still after sometime it asking the same quesstion this is worst i feel.' These pin the fix so it cannot come back. `now` is supplied per case so the window boundary never depends on what time the suite happened to run — that exact defect turned main red once already.

answered.q: should the VTS ETA override the user-entered value?

given.question: should the VTS ETA override the user-entered value?

cases.why: he answered once; asking again after the PR was raised is what he called the worst of it

answered.q: should the VTS ETA override the user-entered value?

given.question: Should the VTS ETA   override the USER-entered value?

cases.why: two renderings of one question differ in whitespace and case; the words do not

answered.q: should the VTS ETA override the user-entered value?

given.question: should the port gate-in date override the user-entered value?

cases.why: reusing his answer to a question he was never asked is worse than asking once too often — deliberately NOT fuzzy

answered.q: which environment should I deploy to?

given.question: which environment should I deploy to?
given.now_offset_note: the stored answer is at ~now; the window is six hours

cases.why: inside the window his answer stands — the boundary case is the one below

given.question: which branch should this go on?

cases.why: an empty history must not fabricate an answer — the failure mode that would be far worse than repeating
a blank question must not collide with a stored one and hand back an unrelated answer
